international.title: US officials recover audio from ‘Mississippi miracle’ cruise ship and tanker crash
international.summary: Tank vessel suffered sudden steering failure two minutes before slamming into docked riverboat near New Orleans Federal safety investigators with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) recovered audio and released a preliminary timeline on Sunday of a collision between a cruise ship and a tanker vessel in the Mississippi River on Friday. The data was retrieved after more than 30 people were injured when a tanker collided with a docked cruise ship – American Cruise Lines’ American Heritage riverboat – near the port of New Orleans on Friday at about 12.30pm. All passengers aboard the cruise ship have been accounted for, officials said. Continue reading...
